name: 1inch Card
summary: DeFi aggregator virtual Mastercard via Baanx. 0% FX fee, auto-converts crypto on purchase. ~2.1% total conversion cost. Up to 2% cashback. €8K daily / €5K monthly limits.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the 1inch Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the 1inch Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
